name: Player Rights Are the White Space
notes: Across all 61 advertisers reviewed for logo/marks, player endorsement, and group player rights, only 3 have any demonstrable player-rights position today: Amica Mutual (Jayson Tatum, individual endorser), H-E-B (a recurring multi-player Spurs commercial series), and Coca-Cola (Donovan Mitchell via BodyArmor). Everything else is team-marks-only — that's the open creative opportunity: most partners have never activated with a player.
